subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step whole number word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student works through a two-step scenario using virtual manipulatives at each step
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a bar model showing two connected steps of a word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a two-step whole number word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: solves only the first step and stops before the second

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
